results.description:
Make the next classroom Christmas party easier to organize. Set up four activity stations, give every group a clear route, and let students check off their stops with a matching passport. This Canva collection brings the organizing pieces together in a warm winter-animal style.

WHAT IS INCLUDED
Four editable stationery functions, each with four coordinated designs featuring Penguin, Polar Bear, Arctic Fox and Bunny:

HOW THE ROTATION WORKS
Split your class into four groups A-D. Number the activity tables 1-4. The included example schedule gives each group a different starting station, then moves every group through all four stations over four rounds. Group route cards follow the same schedule. Students can check or stamp their passport as they visit each station.

The example uses ten-minute rounds with two minutes between them. Change the times for your class. Follow group letters and station numbers; the animals are decoration. An adult supervises activities and tells groups when to move.

ORGANIZER ONLY
You provide the actual activities and supplies. Craft sheets, games, puzzles, storybooks, crayons, stamps and physical decorations are not included. The guide suggests simple ways to set up the four example stations using your own materials.

EDITING IN CANVA
Change the teacher or class name, station labels, group names, routes and times. Text, fonts, text colors, borders, simple shapes and table cells are editable. Each original illustration is a separate movable image; its painted details are fixed. Changes on one page do not automatically update the others, so keep the signs, planner, group cards and passports consistent.

The Reference PDFs are fixed sample files. Use the Canva links to personalize your copies before printing. No seller customization is included. A Canva account and internet are required; a computer is recommended. Canva plan-specific features and mobile editing are not promised.

PRINTING
Export your personalized pages as PDF and print at Actual Size / 100%. Check the paper size and print one test page before printing the full set. Colors vary by screen, printer and paper. Physical printing and classroom use have not been tested.

PLEASE READ
Digital download only. No physical signs, cards, supplies, frames, stands or decorations will be shipped. The opening image is an AI-assisted styled concept of this collection. Flat gallery previews show the included designs; styled scenes may show minor artwork or composition differences.
